[Unit]
# The k7 guest agent: the host's only interface to this VM (exec, file
# transfer, container lifecycle) over vsock.
#
# `StandardError=journal+console` is load-bearing, not logging taste.
# `Vm::connect_agent` polls the VM's serial output for the agent's
# "k7-agent: listening on vsock port …" line before it dials vsock, so
# without this (and `console=ttyS0` on the kernel command line) every
# connect times out on a VM that is in fact perfectly healthy.
Description=k7 guest agent (vsock control plane)
Documentation=https://github.com/katakate/k7d
After=k7d-net.service systemd-modules-load.service local-fs.target
Wants=k7d-net.service

[Service]
Type=simple
# vsock is a module in linux-image-virtual and has no autoload trigger
# on a virtio-mmio-only machine; /etc/modules-load.d/k7d.conf loads it,
# and this is the belt-and-braces for a boot where that raced.
ExecStartPre=-/sbin/modprobe vmw_vsock_virtio_transport
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/k7-agent
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
StandardOutput=journal+console
StandardError=journal+console
